name: PARDUS 瑞豹 Uragano Sport
why_interesting: A current domestic carbon gravel build with an official 45C limit, a complete Shimano 105 R7000 configuration and practical rack and fender mounts.
missing: Current public mainland price and checkout route for that exact build
Domestic warranty duration and claim conditions

facts.drivetrain: Shimano 105 R7000 2×11 with Prowheel 46/30 crank and 11-30 cassette
facts.frame: PARDUS Uragano Sport HS-EPS+ carbon frame with HS-HPT carbon fork
facts.frame_material: PARDUS HS-EPS+ carbon frame and HS-HPT carbon fork; fiber supplier, grade and lay-up are not published
facts.frame_construction: Internally routed carbon gravel chassis with rack, fork and fender mounts and conventional 27.2 mm seatpost
facts.stiffness_evidence: No measured or attributable current-generation exact-build stiffness evidence was found; ride reports for earlier Uragano generations are not transferred
facts.complete_weight_basis: Exact matching 105 R7000 build listed at 9.5 kg in size M by a retailer; pedals, accessories, paint and weighing method are not stated
facts.cockpit: MVMT M-BLACK AL6061 handlebar with 20-degree flare
facts.sizes: XS, S, M, L and XL
facts.mounts: Front and rear rack, fork and fender mounts

source_note: The current official Chinese page supplies the complete 105 R7000 build and 700×45C maximum. A separate exact-build retailer page matches the component package and lists 9.5 kg in size M. Current mainland checkout price and domestic warranty terms remain unresolved.
